usageNotes: Returns the directory index for a specific SDN VNet scoped to a given PDM node — useful as a discoverability call to confirm the VNet exists and to enumerate sub-resources available beneath it. The response type is null (an empty or minimal index object), so this endpoint is primarily a navigation/existence check rather than a data-fetch. SDN must be configured on the node and the VNet name must exactly match an existing VNet identifier.

examples.summary: Confirm existence and enumerate sub-resources for VNet 'vnet10' on node 'pdm01'

tips: VNet names in Proxmox SDN are typically short lowercase identifiers (e.g. 'vnet10', 'dmz'); use list-vnets first to get exact names.
A 404 or empty response indicates the VNet does not exist on that node or SDN is not applied — check SDN zone/subnet configuration.
This endpoint requires no special privilege beyond 'user: all', so API tokens with minimal scope can call it safely.
